The second 1.5.0 beta fixes what testing beta.1 turned up. Saving the trim rules in a server's **World** tab no longer fails with "Validation Error", whatever you change. **Trim unused chunks** now looks at the world in the background, so a big world no longer ends in a 502 followed by "already being looked at": the preview shows how many region files it has got through, and you can close it and come back. The console, crash and log views are readable in light mode again.

The hostname router is sturdier too. Turning on **One address for every server** while a server still holds port 25565 no longer leaves the router failed: it waits for that server's next restart to free the port, then takes it, so nothing needs restarting by hand. New installs get D-Bus set up if the box doesn't have it, and the agent now says plainly when D-Bus is missing.

A box updated from 1.4.x that hasn't got the `dbus` package still needs `sudo apt install dbus`. Testing notes are in [testing-1.5.0.md](https://github.com/teamflytower/flytower/blob/v1.5.0-beta.2/docs/testing/testing-1.5.0.md).
